title: Cell line construction and maintenance for Lyso-IP and Endo-IP analysis
author: Hankum Park

steps.title: Maintain 293 cells
steps.instruction: Culture 293 cells in DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin; maintain 293 EL cells additionally in 1.2 µg ml⁻¹ puromycin and 200 µg ml⁻¹ G418 to select for 3xFLAG‑EEA1 and TMEM192‑3XHA, respectively.

steps.title: Endogenous tag TMEM192
steps.instruction: Co‑transfect 293 cells with (i) pX459 carrying the gRNA 5′‑AGTAGAACGTGAGAGGCTCA targeting the region adjacent to the TMEM192 translational termination sequence, and (ii) pSMART donor plasmid containing 5′ and 3′ homology arms that replace the TMEM192 stop codon with a 3xHA epitope followed by a TAA stop codon (Addgene #175777).

steps.title: Screen TMEM192‑3xHA clones
steps.instruction: Harvest cell extracts, perform immunoblotting with anti‑HA and anti‑TMEM192 antibodies, and identify homozygously targeted clones; designate these as 293 L cells for Lyso‑IP.

steps.title: Construct pHAGE‑EEA1 vector
steps.instruction: Recombine the EEA1 open reading frame from a pENTR vector into the pHAGE‑N‑3xFLAG backbone to generate a puromycin‑resistant pHAGE lentiviral vector expressing 3xFLAG‑EEA1.

steps.title: Produce and infect with EEA1 lentivirus
steps.instruction: Transfect 293T cells with pHAGE‑3xFLAG‑EEA1 (Addgene #176491) and appropriate packaging and envelope plasmids, collect viral supernatant, and infect 293 L cells; select for integration with 1.2 µg ml⁻¹ puromycin and isolate a monoclonal population, which will be called 293 EL cells for Endo‑IP and Lyso‑IP.

substeps.instruction: Transfect 293T cells with vector and packaging plasmids

steps.title: Design APP knockout gRNA
steps.instruction: Phosphorylate and anneal the following oligonucleotides: Top 5′‑CACCGGCGGAATTGACAAGTTCCGA, Bottom 5′‑AAACTCGGAACTTGTCAATTCCGCC, then clone the duplex into the BbsI site of pX459.

steps.title: Knock out APP in 293 EL cells
steps.instruction: Transfect 293 EL cells with the pX459‑gRNA‑APP plasmid (Addgene #176487) using Lipofectamine 3000, select transfectants with 1.2 µg ml⁻¹ puromycin, isolate a monoclonal population, and verify APP deletion by Western blot.

steps.title: Create APP751 ORF with stop codon
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify pENTR‑APP751 (open, no stop codon) using forward primer 5′‑GCAGAACTAGATCCACCCAGCTTTCTTG and reverse primer 5′‑GGGTGGATCTAGTTCTGCATCTGCTCAAAG to replace the native W752 codon with a stop codon.

steps.title: Introduce Sw and T700N mutations
steps.instruction: Perform two rounds of mutagenesis on the APP ORF in pENTR: (i) Sw (K651M/N652L) using the QuickChange II kit with forward 5′‑tcggaattctgcatccagattcacttcagagatctcctccg and reverse 5′‑cggaggagatctctgaagtgaatctggatgcagaattccga; (ii) T700N using the Q5 kit with forward 5′‑ATCGTCATCAACTTGGTGATG and reverse 5′‑CACTGTCGCTATGACAAC. Transfer the resulting APP Sw,T700N ORF into the Gateway destination vector pHAGE‑C‑HA‑FLAG‑puro via Clonase to generate pHAGE‑APP Sw,T700N‑puro. Note that the introduced stop codon prevents translation into the downstream HA‑FLAG tag.

steps.title: Generate stable APP Sw,T700N line
steps.instruction: Produce lentivirus from the pHAGE‑APP Sw,T700N‑puro construct, transduce 293 EL APP‑/‑ cells, and select monoclonal integrants to establish a stable cell line.
